answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. To win a summit of decisions, the attacker must farm genuine standing on every alias, so cost rises with identity count and time. Consider a lantern at the center, a atlas resting nearby, and a haven beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
